difficulty_reason: For a morphism of sites f : C -> D given by u : D -> C commuting with equalizers and fibre products, show u(K) is a hypercovering whenever K is: write u(K_n) = {u(U_i)}; the key identification f^{-1} F(K_n)^# = F(u(K_n))^# follows from f^{-1} h_U^# = h_{u(U)}^# (sites-lemma-pullback-representable-sheaf); conditions (1) and (2) of definition-hypercovering-variant hold because f^{-1} is exact and the maps are pullbacks of surjections; for condition (3) the needed identity F((cosk_n sk_n u(K))_{n+1})^# = f^{-1} F((cosk_n sk_n K)_{n+1})^# reduces to u commuting with the limits defining the coskeleton, which are finite connected limits (simplicial-remark-existence-cosk) and u commutes with them by assumption.
